parameters.name: agentUserId
parameters.description: The id of the agent user that the run works as.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One or more run statuses. To send more than one, repeat the parameter, for example status=FAILED&status=CANCELED.

parameters.name: executor
parameters.description: The executor key, for example hosted.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of runs on a page. The server uses 200 for a larger value.
